advancement_gates: Primary paired mean 95-percent CI lower bound strictly greater than 0
Paired bottom-ceil(0.30*N) participant mean 95-percent CI lower bound at least 0; no positive harm margin is introduced

Only after primary mean and tail gates pass: superiority to PB-RF-6ch, then HPF-unweighted in this fixed order, each paired mean CI lower bound greater than 0; the D9 diagnostic is not a matched-input superiority gate
Mean seed-specific sitting recall improves; mobility recall and negative-log-likelihood do not worsen; otherwise report a tradeoff and do not promote
True specialist must outperform its shuffled-label negative control; no candidate promotion if the mechanism is unnecessary
artifact_contract: New create-only directory, clean launch manifest, frozen protocol and dataset receipts, all-seed probabilities, split audit, result self-hash, independent reconstruction, command exit status, explicit failure record. No raw dataset or large model artifacts committed.

basis.previous_hera_full_primary_gate: failed on corrected FoG; no further HERA routing search

comparison_tuple: Primary and mechanism contrasts use identical six-channel inputs, raw hashes, participant set, ontology, corrected physical segment/window grid, seed folds, supervision and participant metrics. PB-RF-D9 is a separate derived-gravity representation row and not a fully matched before/after comparator.
compute_matching: 500 total trees per configuration; report tree/node counts, serialized trusted-local model bytes, feature dimensions, fitting and inference wall time. Tree budget is matched, parameter counts and runtime need not be equal.
costs: Equal false-sitting and false-standing cost within each participant/class task; rare support addressed by fixed training mass, not post hoc thresholds. No learned probability calibration or decision threshold search.

datasets.conditional_replication: Only if every advancement gate passes: the already declared IMU-HAR-IL available-trials-v1 cohort, a development replication, not confirmation
datasets.primary: FoG-STAR record 17838806, all 22 participants, corrected session-grid-v3; development-consumed

features: Inherited deterministic engineered per-window features, no new feature search or normalization fitting on evaluation data. Derived gravity remains distinct from native gravity.
hypothesis: The corrected FoG dataset has only 74 sitting windows among 1213 and unequal per-person support. Equal participant/class training mass and a stationary/posture probability factorization may improve rare-posture recognition without harming mean or lower-tail participant F1.
inference: Independent window features only; P(mobility)=root probability, P(sitting)=(1-P(mobility))*specialist sitting probability, P(standing)=(1-P(mobility))*specialist standing probability. No labels, identity metadata, reset oracle, tuning or test-time personalization accepted.

model_variants.HPF-unweighted: 250-tree six-channel mobility-versus-stationary root plus 250-tree six-channel sitting-versus-standing specialist, balanced_subsample; no participant weighting
model_variants.PB-HPF: Same six-channel 250+250 hierarchy, with participant/class sample weights for each task; sole candidate
model_variants.PB-HPF-shuffled-posture: Same six-channel candidate but shuffle specialist training labels within each training participant using the fixed negative-control RNG; evaluation labels never altered or accepted by inference
model_variants.PB-RF-6ch: 500-tree flat six-channel forest; replace class_weight with fixed participant/class sample weights
model_variants.PB-RF-D9: Same flat participant/class-balanced forest, derived nine channels; gravity and weighting control
model_variants.RandomForest-6ch: Exact inherited 500-tree baseline, sqrt max_features, min_samples_leaf 2, balanced_subsample, n_jobs 1; require exact reproduction of retained base class decisions and participant metrics

multiplicity: One primary candidate and a fixed-sequence intersection of advancement gates; all other contrasts, individual seeds and sensitivity metrics descriptive. No selection of a different configuration if the sole candidate fails.
novelty_scope: A prospective test of a motivated combination, not a claim that activity hierarchies or participant weighting are new. Generic hierarchical HAR has prior literature and official Sole-HARmony implementations.

pre_outcome_amendment.reason: The v1 candidate posture branch used derived-nine channels while the strongest baseline used six. Match the full primary input tuple by giving both candidate branches six channels. Retain D9 as a separately labeled representation diagnostic, never a matched before/after gain.

pre_outcome_seed_mapping_correction.reason: Inspection of the exact inherited FoG baseline call confirms estimator seed is seed+outer_fold, not the seed+101*fold used in HAR-PMD. Use seed+outer_fold for exact matched baseline reconstruction.

primary_metric: Mean across seeds of equally weighted participant fixed-three-class macro-F1; participant-cluster bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 20260905, paired resampling across methods and all seeds
seed_derivation: seed + outer_fold; specialist seed additionally +10000; shuffled negative seed additionally +20000
selection_and_stop_rule: Run one corrected-FoG suite from a clean committed implementation. If any advancement gate fails, stop expansion of this candidate and retain the negative/tradeoff result. Only after all gates pass run one fixed IMU available-trials development replication; do not retune on it.
training_weights: Each participant has equal total mass; their observed classes divide that mass equally; within participant/class, windows have equal weight. Normalize mean weight to 1. Root weights use the binary mobility label; specialist weights use only stationary training windows. Never use evaluation participant identity for prediction.
